```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,message = FALSE,warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "svg",
                      dpi = 600, out.width = "100%", out.height = "100%",
                      echo = FALSE,
                      cache = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringdist)
library(igraph)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ForceAtlas2)
```

# Construct clonal network graph from all sc clones, colored by infections
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the data
cdr3_sc_hc <- read_tsv("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3/cdr3_sc_hc.tsv")
cdr3_sc_lc <- read_tsv("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3/cdr3_sc_lc.tsv")

# Calculate the pairwise distance between CDR3 sequences
threshold <- 1 # Setting the threshold for LV distance, CDR3 sequences with LV distance 1 will be connected
```


```{r}
# Compute all pairwise LV distance between the CDRH3 sequences
cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist <- stringdistmatrix(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv")
cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist <- stringdistmatrix(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv")
cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist <- stringdistmatrix(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv")
cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist <- stringdistmatrix(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv")
cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist <- stringdistmatrix(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv")
cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist <- stringdistmatrix(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv")

# Convert the dist object into a matrix
cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist <- as.matrix(cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist)
cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist <- as.matrix(cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist)
cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist <- as.matrix(cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist)
cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist <- as.matrix(cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist)
cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist <- as.matrix(cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist)
cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist <- as.matrix(cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist)

rownames(cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
rownames(cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
rownames(cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
rownames(cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
rownames(cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
rownames(cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))


colnames(cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
colnames(cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
colnames(cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
colnames(cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
colnames(cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
colnames(cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(CDR3.aa))

# Set the matrix into binary, either under the threshold or not to determine whether edge will be drawn
cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist[cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist<=threshold] <- 1
cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist[cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist<=threshold] <- 1
cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist[cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist<=threshold] <- 1
cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist[cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist<=threshold] <- 1
cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist[cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist<=threshold] <- 1
cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist[cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist<=threshold] <- 1

cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist[cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist>threshold] <- 0
cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist[cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist>threshold] <- 0
cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist[cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist>threshold] <- 0
cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist[cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist>threshold] <- 0
cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist[cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist>threshold] <- 0
cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist[cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist>threshold] <- 0

# Create graph based on set threshold
cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist, weighted=T, mode = "undirected"))
cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist, weighted=T, mode = "undirected"))
cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist, weighted=T, mode = "undirected"))
cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist, weighted=T, mode = "undirected"))
cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist, weighted=T, mode = "undirected"))
cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist, weighted=T, mode = "undirected"))
```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Calculate the graph layout
cdr3_sc_1_hc_layout <- layout.forceatlas2(cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist, directed=FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity=1, ks=0.1, ksmax=10, delta = 1,  center=NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2,plotstep=100, plotlabels=FALSE)
cdr3_sc_2_hc_layout <- layout.forceatlas2(cdr3_sc_2_hc_dist, directed=FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity=1, ks=0.1, ksmax=10, delta = 1,  center=NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2,plotstep=100, plotlabels=FALSE)
cdr3_sc_3_hc_layout <- layout.forceatlas2(cdr3_sc_3_hc_dist, directed=FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity=1, ks=0.1, ksmax=10, delta = 1,  center=NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2,plotstep=100, plotlabels=FALSE)
cdr3_sc_1_lc_layout <- layout.forceatlas2(cdr3_sc_1_lc_dist, directed=FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity=1, ks=0.1, ksmax=10, delta = 1,  center=NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2,plotstep=100, plotlabels=FALSE)
cdr3_sc_2_lc_layout <- layout.forceatlas2(cdr3_sc_2_lc_dist, directed=FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity=1, ks=0.1, ksmax=10, delta = 1,  center=NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2,plotstep=100, plotlabels=FALSE)
cdr3_sc_3_lc_layout <- layout.forceatlas2(cdr3_sc_3_lc_dist, directed=FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity=1, ks=0.1, ksmax=10, delta = 1,  center=NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2,plotstep=100, plotlabels=FALSE)

saveRDS(cdr3_sc_1_hc_layout, "Clonal_network_analysis/layout/cdr3_sc_1_hc_layout")
saveRDS(cdr3_sc_2_hc_layout, "Clonal_network_analysis/layout/cdr3_sc_2_hc_layout")
saveRDS(cdr3_sc_3_hc_layout, "Clonal_network_analysis/layout/cdr3_sc_3_hc_layout")
saveRDS(cdr3_sc_1_lc_layout, "Clonal_network_analysis/layout/cdr3_sc_1_lc_layout")
saveRDS(cdr3_sc_2_lc_layout, "Clonal_network_analysis/layout/cdr3_sc_2_lc_layout")
saveRDS(cdr3_sc_3_lc_layout, "Clonal_network_analysis/layout/cdr3_sc_3_lc_layout")
```


```{r include=FALSE}
# Create a color vector for HA binding
color_binding_sc_1_hc <- factor(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(HA.binding))
color_binding_sc_2_hc <- factor(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(HA.binding))
color_binding_sc_3_hc <- factor(cdr3_sc_hc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(HA.binding))
color_binding_sc_1_lc <- factor(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "1") %>% pull(HA.binding))
color_binding_sc_2_lc <- factor(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "2") %>% pull(HA.binding))
color_binding_sc_3_lc <- factor(cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Replicate == "3") %>% pull(HA.binding))

levels(color_binding_sc_1_hc) <- c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8")
levels(color_binding_sc_2_hc) <- c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8")
levels(color_binding_sc_3_hc) <- c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8")
levels(color_binding_sc_1_lc) <- c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8")
levels(color_binding_sc_2_lc) <- c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8")
levels(color_binding_sc_3_lc) <- c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8")
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
# Open a pdf file
pdf("./Clonal_network_analysis/figures/network_sc_1_hc_binding.pdf", width = 12, height = 12, pointsize = 8)
# plot
plot(cdr3_sc_1_hc_dist, layout = cdr3_sc_1_hc_layout, vertex.frame.color = NA, vertex.label = NA,
     vertex.color = as.character(color_binding_sc_1_hc), 
     vertex.size = 2, edge.width = 0.2, edge.color = "gray60",rescale = TRUE)
     legend(x = 0.95, y = 1, c("CA07", "Cross", "PR8"), pch = 21, col = "#777777",
     pt.bg = levels(color_binding_sc_1_hc), pt.cex = 2, cex = .8, bty = "n", ncol = 1)
# close
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Split the mouse samples CDR3 by infection group

cdr3_sc_lc_PBS_PBS_2 <- cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Infections == "PBS;PBS" & Replicate == "2")

cdr3_sc_lc_PR8_CA07_1 <- cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Infections == "PR8;CA07" & Replicate == "1")
cdr3_sc_lc_PR8_CA07_2 <- cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Infections == "PR8;CA07" & Replicate == "2")
cdr3_sc_lc_PR8_CA07_3 <- cdr3_sc_lc %>% filter(Infections == "PR8;CA07" & Replicate == "3")

# Compute all pairwise LV distance between the CDRH3 sequences
cdr3_sc_infections <- lapply(ls(pattern = "cdr3_sc_hc_|cdr3_sc_lc_"), get)
names(cdr3_sc_infections) <- ls(pattern = "cdr3_sc_hc_|cdr3_sc_lc_")

cdr3_sc_infections_dist <- lapply(cdr3_sc_infections, function(x) stringdistmatrix(x %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv"))

# Convert the dist object into a matrix
# Set the matrix into binary, either under the threshold or not to determine whether edge will be drawn
# Create graph based on set threshold
cdr3_sc_infections_dist <- lapply(cdr3_sc_infections_dist, function(x) as.matrix(x))
for(i in 1:length(cdr3_sc_infections_dist)){
  rownames(cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]]) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_infections[[i]] %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
  colnames(cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]]) <- as.character(cdr3_sc_infections[[i]] %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
  cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]][cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]] <= threshold] <- 1
  cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]][cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]] > threshold] <- 0
  cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]] <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_sc_infections_dist[[i]], weighted = T, mode = "undirected"))
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
cdr3_sc_infections_layout <- lapply(cdr3_sc_infections_dist, function(x) layout.forceatlas2(x, directed = FALSE, iterations = 200, linlog = FALSE, pos = NULL, nohubs = FALSE, k = 400, gravity = 1, ks = 0.1, ksmax = 10, delta = 1, center = NULL, tolerance = 0.1, dim = 2, plotstep = 100, plotlabels = FALSE))

map2(.x = cdr3_sc_infections_layout, .y = names(cdr3_sc_infections_layout), function(x,y) saveRDS(x, paste0("Clonal_network_analysis/layout/",y,"_layout")))
```

# Construct clonal network graph from top 1000 bulk clones, colored by HA binding
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the data
path_bulk_hc <- list.files("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3_bulk_top1000/", pattern = "hc", full.names = T)
path_bulk_lc <- list.files("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3_bulk_top1000/", pattern = "lc", full.names = T)

cdr3_bulk_hc <- map(path_bulk_hc, function(x) read_tsv(x))
names(cdr3_bulk_hc) <- str_sub(list.files("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3_bulk_top1000/", pattern = "hc"), end = -5L)
cdr3_bulk_lc <- map(path_bulk_lc, function(x) read_tsv(x))
names(cdr3_bulk_lc) <- str_sub(list.files("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3_bulk_top1000/", pattern = "lc"), end = -5L)

# Calculate the pairwise distance between CDR3 sequences
threshold <- 1 # Setting the threshold for LV distance, CDR3 sequences with LV distance 1 will be connected
```

```{r}
# Compute all pairwise LV distance between the CDR3 sequences
cdr3_bulk_hc_dist <- lapply(cdr3_bulk_hc, function(x) stringdistmatrix(x %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv"))
cdr3_bulk_lc_dist <- lapply(cdr3_bulk_lc, function(x) stringdistmatrix(x %>% pull(CDR3.aa), method = "lv"))

# Convert the dist object into a matrix
# Set the matrix into binary, either under the threshold or not to determine whether edge will be drawn
# Create graph based on set threshold
cdr3_bulk_hc_dist <- lapply(cdr3_bulk_hc_dist, function(x) as.matrix(x))
for(i in 1:length(cdr3_bulk_hc_dist)){
  rownames(cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]]) <- as.character(cdr3_bulk_hc[[i]] %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
  colnames(cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]]) <- as.character(cdr3_bulk_hc[[i]] %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
  cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]][cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]] <= threshold] <- 1
  cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]][cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]] > threshold] <- 0
  cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]] <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_bulk_hc_dist[[i]], weighted = T, mode = "undirected"))
}

cdr3_bulk_lc_dist <- lapply(cdr3_bulk_lc_dist, function(x) as.matrix(x))
for(i in 1:length(cdr3_bulk_lc_dist)){
  rownames(cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]]) <- as.character(cdr3_bulk_lc[[i]] %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
  colnames(cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]]) <- as.character(cdr3_bulk_lc[[i]] %>% pull(CDR3.aa))
  cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]][cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]] <= threshold] <- 1
  cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]][cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]] > threshold] <- 0
  cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]] <- igraph::simplify(graph.adjacency(cdr3_bulk_lc_dist[[i]], weighted = T, mode = "undirected"))
}
```

